questions.label: Email
options: Record my email address with my response
questions.note: Google's verified-email box (required): ticking it records the signed-in Google account's address. There is nothing to type, and it needs the applicant's own Google sign-in.

questions.label: Please select the age range of those living in your household (select all that apply)
questions.note: Asks which age bands (0-18, 19-26, 27-35, over 35) anyone in the household falls in. The profile only counts under 18, 18-64 and 65+, so the bands don't line up. Proposed rule: householdAgeBands.

questions.label: Please indicate the size of your household (total amount of people living within your residence)
questions.note: Options stop at 5; a larger household would type its size into the dropped Other box. The page also has an "Other:" free-text option, left out here.

questions.label: Have you previously used any services provided by Canterbury House or participated in events?
questions.note: Past use of Canterbury House services. The page also has an "Other:" free-text option, left out here.

questions.label: Day of completing this form:
questions.note: Today's date, not a saved fact.

questions.label: Which items would you like? (select up to 10)
questions.note: Food item choices. The page also has an "Other:" free-text option, left out here.
